purpose: Adapters for five strict nineteenth-century microscope-slide collection nodes with explicit surviving physical holdings, cabinet/subcollection structure, or item identifiers.
guards: Keep historical collection states separate from present surviving totals; a nineteenth-century purchase count, a present surviving count and a cabinet capacity are different quantities.
Do not flatten 'produced or collected by' into 'prepared by'; Quekett and other historical collectors incorporated material made by multiple preparators.
Mixed-period collections that begin before 1900 require a separately recoverable nineteenth-century layer; current totals extending into the twentieth century are not nineteenth-century counts.
Current object numbers and accession identifiers document museum custody and cataloguing, not original nineteenth-century sequence or ownership.
Preserve current cabinet, tray, division, handwritten-ledger and item-register structures because they may encode later rearrangement as well as historical order.

adapters.institution_scope: Royal College of Surgeons of England / Hunterian Museum John Thomas Quekett microscope-slide subcollection
adapters.target: Hunterian microscope-slide collection page, RCS collections policy, RCS Quekett history pages and SurgiCat item records
adapters.promotion_rule: Harvest RCSMS/Quekett identifiers, division/series structure, object labels and source-specimen relations when exposed; preserve the 1846 purchase of 2,500 preparations as a historical state and the approximately 12,000 surviving produced-or-collected slides as a distinct present subcollection state.

adapters.institution_scope: Science Museum Group microscope-slide cabinet Y2001.223
adapters.target: official SMG object page, JSON catalogue entry, parts hierarchy and IIIF manifest
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture compound-object and part identifiers, maker/date statements, material categories and IIIF metadata; retain the slide batch as a large but uncounted historical collection and do not infer a count from cabinet dimensions.

adapters.institution_scope: Manchester Museum Sydney/Sidney Chaffers diatom slide collection
adapters.target: peer-reviewed University of Manchester collection study plus University museum/public-engagement references to current Manchester Museum custody
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture cabinet structure, Chaffers-prepared versus commercially acquired slides and any dated labels or accession records exposed by Manchester Museum; isolate pre-1900 slides from the 1895-1904 formation span rather than treating all six cabinets as nineteenth-century.

adapters.institution_scope: Whipple Museum case of microscope slides accession 2385B
adapters.target: official Whipple Museum object record for case 2385B and linked catalogue metadata
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the mixed commercial and homemade character, Pritchard-labelled subgroup, three-tray physical structure, 'IB 1860' monogram and 1978 Sotheby's acquisition as separate preparation, collection and custody evidence; leave the exact extant slide count unresolved.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Glasgow Hunterian Matthew Forster Heddle rock and mineral thin-section collection
adapters.target: official University of Glasgow Hunterian digitisation/history pages and older handwritten geological-slide ledgers
adapters.promotion_rule: Recover Heddle-attributed thin sections and ledger references item by item where possible; keep the Heddle subtotal unresolved inside the Hunterian's approximately 40,000 geological-slide collection and do not attribute preparation to Heddle when the source only establishes collection or acquisition.
